mentions.name: nix-ci
mentions.description: A continuous integration service that requires no configuration, runs builds in seconds instead of minutes, and reproduces builds locally.
mentions.problem: CI usually involves configuration, takes around 30 minutes to run, and is not reproducible locally.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://nix-ci.com

What if CI didn't have to involve any configuration, could run in 30sec instead of 30min, and would be reproducible locally?
